title: Inserting an endotracheal tube.png
author: Munoz; Cayetano S.
caption: Diagram of direct laryngoscopy and endotracheal tube insertion into the trachea for definitive airway management.
alt_text: Cross-sectional medical diagram showing a laryngoscope and endotracheal tube passing through the vocal cords into the trachea.
clinical_relevance: Represents advanced airway intervention (intubation/cricothyrotomy) required in worst-case refractory airway obstruction per NASA CliFF-067.
